### The Bread of Life
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-13-2026.html
Passage: Matthew 26:26
Points:
- Traditional Passover Seders feature taking unleavened bread from the middle pouch, breaking it, and sharing it.
- Jesus took this middle loaf at the Last Supper and identified it as His body.
- Breaking the bread represented Christ's physical death on the cross.
- The Passover blessing praising God for bringing forth bread foreshadowed Jesus rising from the grave.

### The Last Supper
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-9-2025.html
Passage: Matthew 26:27-28
Points:
- God orchestrated every detail to prepare a room for Jesus and the disciples' final Passover.
- Jesus used the meal's elements to explain that His body and blood were given as a sacrifice.
- Christ's shed blood establishes the new covenant, covering sin and making believers righteous before God.
- Partaking in Communion reminds believers of Christ's sacrifice and compels them to proclaim that message.
